verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents that Skills can be configured to auto-invoke when Claude judges them 'relevant' (docs-3, docs-25, docs-34), which is the closest analog to rule-based automatic triggering—there's no true event-driven (e.g., webhook/schedule/file-change) rule engine evidenced, only semantic-relevance triggering by the model itself. Hands-on community reports directly contradict reliable automatic triggering: Vercel found skills were never invoked in 56% of eval cases despite being available, and multiple users report auto-invocation is 'hit or miss' even with explicit YAML triggers, sometimes requiring manual instruction to use them. Missing for 10: genuine event-based rule definitions (not just semantic relevance), reliable automatic firing without manual prompting, and evidence of true trigger-on-event automation outside the coding-agent context.
